g.text: GrainGEMM G256: CuTe vs. Triton vs. BF16

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #44546a

g.text: NVIDIA Thor | GPU clock reduced to 1.2 GHz (1197 MHz) | M = N = K: 1024–16384 | 16 measured sizes | Prequantized INT8 inputs | BF16 output

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #44546a

g.text: Timing: median of 5 round medians with CUDA Graphs; target captured batch 100 ms. Shading: round min–max, not confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #44546a

g.text: Each point is one measured square size. Throughput = 2MNK / time: INT8 uses integer TOPS; BF16 uses floating-point TFLOPS.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #44546a

g.text: GEMM includes group scaling, accumulation, and output conversion. Quantization, compilation, autotuning, and warmup are excluded.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #44546a

g.text: Forced backends; repeated inputs; no cache flush. Per-size kernel settings, graph checks, and raw rounds are in the JSON.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #65758b
